cohort: 1,762 women who delivered between 2004 and 2016 at University Hospital of Zurich
finding: The rate of instrumental delivery and C-section increased in the setting of a larger head circumference and greater birth weight.
mod_finding: The main prognostic factor for instrumental delivery was size of head circumference: > = 36 cm, but not macrosomia.
birth_weight: birth weight data was collected, but no specific weight is mentioned
